comment: Shared terminal prompts, menus, and model picker rows.

WORKING.comment: Find the working indicator or interrupt hint.

APPROVAL_QUESTION.regex: ^(?:Claude has written up a plan.*Would you like to proceed|Ready to code\?|Quick safety check|Run this command\?|Would you like to \w+|Do you want to (?:proceed|allow|approve|make this edit|create)|Do you trust|Trust this (?:folder|directory|project)|Allow access to|Allow this|trust.{0,100}(?:folder|directory|project)|(?:folder|directory|project).{0,100}trust)
APPROVAL_QUESTION.comment: Find the question that starts an approval prompt.

DIALOG_FRAME.comment: Find an approval dialog rule or generic question.

CURSOR_ITEM.comment: Find the selected numbered menu item.

CHAT_LINE.comment: Find chat output that makes an older menu inactive.

INPUT_HINT.regex: esc Close|↑/↓ Scroll|Enter to (?:select|confirm|continue)|↑/?↓ (?:to )?(?:navigate|select)|enter Select|Esc to cancel|press enter|press any key|\benter\s+\S+\s*[·•]\s*esc\b|Keyboard:|\(y/n\)|\[y/n\]|\(yes/no\)
INPUT_HINT.comment: Find a terminal input or navigation hint.

RULE_LINE.comment: Find a row made only of dialog frame characters.

PICKER_CURSOR.comment: Read the selected unnumbered picker label.

PICKER_MORE.comment: Read the direction and count of hidden picker items.

PICKER_HINT.comment: Find the Enter and Esc footer of a cursor picker.

PICKER_HINT_START.comment: Find the first row of a wrapped cursor picker footer.

MENU_HINT_START.comment: Find the first row of a wrapped numbered menu footer.

PARTIAL_PICKER_HINT.comment: Find an incomplete picker footer before closing a panel.

GENERIC.regex: ^(?:Do you want to proceed\?|Would you like to proceed\?|Permission rule .*|Requesting permission for:?)$
GENERIC.comment: Find generic permission text to omit from a request summary.

MODEL_NUMBERED.comment: Read a model row marker, number, and body.

MODEL_LEVEL_IN_NAME.comment: Find an effort level included in a model name.

MODEL_CONFIRMATION.comment: Find the terminal confirmation of a model or effort change.
